description: This file defines the 'AllOf' class within the composite validation rules of the OrangeHRM API v2, specifically in the validator rules submodule. The class extends an abstract composite and provides the specific rule class 'Respect\Validation\Rules\AllOf' for composite validation logic.

classes.name: AllOf
classes.description: A validation rule class representing a composite 'all of' rule, combining multiple validation rules.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the specific validation rule that this composite rule uses, in this case 'Respect\Validation\Rules\AllOf'.
